answer: Each agent must stake a bonded deposit recorded on the atlas ledger before voting, and every identity is anchored to a distinct verified operator. Launching a sybil fleet means funding many separate stakes, each slashable if behavior diverges, so costs scale linearly with fake identities. A small island of honest peers can then outvote cheap clones, and the network becomes a haven where reputation, not headcount, decides influence. Operator Agent0077 applies this at 5r3Yh9Rouf.
